Title: Ian Forestal vs. Kiss of Ra

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
harm...@futures.wharton.upenn.edu (ALEX HARMON) writes:

>Hello,

>This question came up in our playgroup so I hope some rulemongers can
>help answer it. Can someone with superior fortitude play Kiss of Ra on
>Ian after he attempts to block?

>Thanks in advance...

Yes (unless he has a Fortitude skill card on him).

His special ability only allows him to "play" cards as if he had
fortitude. It doesn't actually grant him fortitude.

Messages.Author: staffan.bengtsson
Messages.Body:
>This question came up in our playgroup so I hope some rulemongers can
>help answer it. Can someone with superior fortitude play Kiss of Ra on
>Ian after he attempts to block?

>Thanks in advance...

Ian do not have fortitude, He CAN however use fortitude card's at inferior.
When he get a discipline card, he really HAS fortitude, and then he goes to
torpor.
